title: OperationAssignmentV3
description: Current RabbitMQ assignment envelope after a Go scheduler placement. Java commits Operation QUEUED -> ASSIGNED, stores assigned_at / assigned_worker_id / current_assignment_id (SchedulingDecision.id), and publishes this JSON to routing key worker.{workerId}. POST /internal/operations/{id}/start must send the same assignmentId. Obsolete v2 messages are rejected so they cannot skip assignment identity checks. v3 does not include attemptId.

policy.description: Operation ordering policy. Always FIFO in this phase.

workerPolicy.description: Worker placement policy. Extra v3 field ignored by workers; PostgreSQL assignment identity is still assignmentId.

assignmentId.description: SchedulingDecision.id for this placement. Distinguishes a delayed old assignment from a later reassignment of the same operation.
